headline: 英倫視覺藝術一週評
context: Apple TV新劇《Lucky》讓Anya Taylor-Joy飾演一位邊逃亡邊搞笑的女騙子，被形容是「無腦又好看」的夏日消遣。倫敦白教堂畫廊（Whitechapel Gallery）的最新聯展則評價慘烈，被批評主題模糊、脈絡交代不清。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: This series about a conwoman fleeing for her life is packed with explosions and preposterous coincidences. It’s bunkum with bells on – but who can resist it in this heat? Luciana “Lucky” Armstrong (Anya Taylor‑Joy) is on the run, scampering across the US in her fashionably rumpled sateen blouson and prompting much fist-shaking from the hapless feds on her tail. “Lucky!” they bellow, cheeks puffing in disbelief as the incorrigible grifter bounds across the roofs of parked lorries, wriggles out of an exploding car, scams a sobbing gran and sets fire to a goon’s cowboy boots. “Lucky?! Stop!” But, no, too late, she’s off again; capering, conning and smirking her way through the Apple TV crime thriller that bears her pointedly ambiguous nickname. Based on Marissa Stapley’s bestselling novel, the story follows thus: after her boyfriend has made off with the proceeds of their multimillion-dollar heist, our penniless protagonist finds herself pursued by the FBI and a ruthless crime boss determined to relieve the duo of their ill-gotten spoils. sources.title: Lucky review – Anya Taylor-Joy’s daft thriller is classic summer viewing

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Whitechapel Gallery, London I feel bad for the artists whose work has been crowbarred into a wonky show about migration, protest, climate and identity It’s rare that an exhibition is so bad you feel compelled to text a friend saying “you wouldn’t believe the garbage I just saw” as soon as you get out. And if you can walk around this badly explained, undercontextualised, barely linked, poorly thought through mess of a show without getting a migraine, you have a stronger constitution than me. This is an exhibition about east London. Or maybe it’s about Britishness. Or migration. Or the climate crisis. Or music. Or global trade. Whitechapel Gallery doesn’t seem to really know, so what chance do the rest of us have of figuring it out? The gallery would argue it’s about all of these things; I’d say it manages to be about none of them. Continue reading...
sources.title: Backyard Biennial: East review – this morose and meaningless exhibition gave me a migraine

thread_text:
Apple TV新劇《Lucky》，讓Anya Taylor-Joy飾演一位邊逃亡邊耍寶的女騙子，被形容是「無腦又好看」的夏日消遣。演唱會方面，七零年代傳奇歌手James Taylor在愛丁堡城堡開唱，被讚金嗓子在最簡單的編制下最動人。攝影專題回顧了巴西世界盃傳奇球星Jairzinho的經典瞬間。至於倫敦白教堂畫廊（Whitechapel Gallery）的最新聯展，評價就沒那麼客氣了——被批評主題模糊、脈絡交代不清，讓人看得一頭霧水。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 15、16 日的報導。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 15、16 日的報導。
voice_text: 《Lucky》這部新劇，女主角一邊逃亡，一邊耍寶。故事裡她是個女騙子，被形容成「無腦又好看」的夏日消遣。七零年代的傳奇歌手，這次在愛丁堡城堡開唱，金嗓子在最簡單的編制下反而最動人。還有一組攝影專題，回顧了巴西世界盃傳奇球星的經典瞬間。倫敦一間畫廊的最新聯展，評價就沒那麼客氣了——主題模糊、脈絡交代不清，看完讓人一頭霧水。
